sources.revision: No Git commit. Pin a dated PMC OAI-PMH/Cloud inventory snapshot, complete PMCID identifier manifest SHA-256, OAI datestamps/article versions, and each downloaded payload SHA-256 before treating any batch as reproducible.
sources.reported_size: Not estimated; count only from a pinned inventory and exact accepted per-article licenses.
sources.reported_license: Article-level. Accept only exact CC-BY-4.0 or CC0-1.0. Reject CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-ND, all NC, other versions, custom, missing, or ambiguous license statements.
language: multilingual; measure per-record, do not assume English-only or balanced coverage
sources.known_lineage: PubMed Central Open Access Subset, maintained by NIH/NLM. Article and preprint records are deposited by publishers/authors; rights remain with the respective copyright holders. PMC inclusion is not a blanket license.
sources.acquisition_plan: After the current mutually exclusive acquisition runs finish, pilot at most 5,000 full-text records. Use only the official PMC OAI-PMH or Cloud service; first enumerate metadata and license, then fetch full text only for records whose article-level license URI exactly matches CC-BY-4.0 or CC0-1.0. Snapshot the complete PMCID list and all payload hashes.
sources.official_license_search: ("cc by license"[filter] OR "cc0 license"[filter]) AND "open access"[filter]; still validate the exact article-level license URI in the record before retrieval/admission.
sources.official_retrieval: PMC OAI-PMH v2.0 at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/api/oai/v1/mh/ (metadataPrefix=pmc_fm for metadata; metadataPrefix=pmc for full text) or PMC Cloud Service. Never scrape the main PMC website.
sources.retrieval_rate_limit: PMC OAI-PMH: maximum 3 requests/second; for >100 requests, run outside US Eastern peak hours and do not issue concurrent requests.
required_checks: Use only PMC-authorized OAI-PMH, Cloud, E-Utilities or BioC services for automated retrieval; never bulk scrape the main PMC site
Pin dated inventory/search snapshot, full PMCID list, OAI datestamps/article versions and manifest SHA-256
Read article-level license metadata first; fetch full text only when exact CC-BY-4.0 or CC0-1.0 is present
Reject CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-ND, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-NC-SA, CC-BY-NC-ND, custom, absent, conflicting or unknown licenses
Retain author, title, journal, DOI, PMCID, publication/version date, license URI, copyright statement and attribution
Exclude third-party figures/media/supplementary files, retracted/withdrawn records, and content whose reuse rights are not covered by the article license
Inspect for PII, identifiable patient data, sensitive clinical narratives, secrets and unsafe content; exclude or quarantine uncertain records
Run language/quality audits, exact and approximate deduplication against the entire corpus, and global validation/test/holdout contamination checks
Human-review stratified samples by journal, domain, year, language and license before any admission
sources.rights_caveat: PMC explicitly states that license terms vary by article, that NLM does not hold copyright, and that users are responsible for each copyright holder's terms. The broad OA subset and the commercial-use grouping also contain BY-SA and BY-ND articles; those are not accepted by this project. Search filters are discovery aids, not substitutes for exact per-article license verification.

storage_policy: Do not commit multi-gigabyte corpora to Git history. Keep immutable manifests, source revisions, checksums and curation reports in Git; keep bulk data in an explicitly configured object store or dataset host. GitHub Actions runners/artifacts are for bounded staging and audit, not permanent 500 GB storage.
